neet_phy_u07_t02_2.working: F2 = F1(A2/A1) = 200 × 50 = 10^4 N. Volume is conserved, so d2 = d1(A1/A2) = 25/50 = 0.5 cm.

neet_phy_u07_t02_3.working: Pressure at the base is P = ρgh. It depends only on depth, not on vessel shape, so it is the same in all three (hydrostatic paradox).

neet_phy_u07_t02_4.working: Pascal's law gives equal pressure on both pistons, so F2 = F1A2/A1. This is exactly why a small force supports a large load, so R correctly explains A.

neet_phy_u07_t02_5.working: An open-tube manometer measures P − Patm, which is gauge pressure, so I is true. 1 atm = 1.013 bar > 1 bar, and NCERT defines 1 torr = 1 mm Hg, so II is true.
